profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at NVIDIA
profile.summary:
Computer graphics programmer. Primary interests are in high performance graphics algorithms, and realistic rendering. A strong interest in interactive/immersive environments involving multimodal interaction techniques.

Specialties: Computer graphics

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description: Working on software interface architecture in the AV platform team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working on the Autonomous Vehicles DriveWorks core team.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: I worked in the Virtual Reality Lab at NRL as a grad student summer intern. My work focused on adding spatial audio support to existing virtual reality environments. I was also involved in the general upgrading and maintenance of the VR/AR library in use at the lab. Most of the work I did focused on the main CAVE system (setting up an 8 speaker cube audio configuration, running on open source drivers adapted to our environment). Engineering results were published in Linux Journal.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Variety of programming tasks, from client to server. Programming tasks involved cryptography, network protocols, database programming, GUI programming, and server performance analysis and tuning.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description: Started out doing client QA for NaviPress (later to become AOLPress), a WYSIWYG web editor/browser. Eventually moved into server QA for NaviServer/AOLServer and some simple server programming and support tasks before the company was absorbed into the greater AOL.
